data.mission_parameters: {"swarm_solution":"App for booking appointments at verified clinics and pharmacies, with integrated digital prescription records and medication authentication.","expansion_markets":["Francophone West Africa"],"key_differentiator":"Pharmacy Verification & Drug Authentication Network","revenue_model":["Subscription fees from clinics/pharmacies for premium listings and management tools","transaction fee on prepaid appointments"],"core_problem":"Chaotic, walk-in only systems at many clinics and pharmacies; no medical history continuity; counterfeit drugs.","first_market":"Côte d'Ivoire","dependent_on":"INF-001"}
